static_traits.name: Lin Sha
static_traits.social_status: Has friends and family to talk about general issues with,but has not yet discussed these specific feelings with them
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological issues before;has not yet received psychotherapy or counseling;no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly,highly cooperative,able to identify and report 'should' statements and self-comparison;frequent self-criticism;speech rate and logic Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Persistent dissatisfaction with self,repeatedly having thoughts like 'I should be bigger and bolder,cannot just be an ordinary American youth';comparing with others worsens stress,affecting self-esteem and overall well-being.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling support because persistent stress and dissatisfaction with self affect daily life and Interpersonal relationships.
growth_experiences: After falling in love this summer,strong self-dissatisfaction began to appear along with pressure of 'should become more successful,more outgoing,more impressive';since then,almost daily triggered when seeing others achieve or take risks,gradually affecting Learning performance,Interpersonal relationships and mood.

Long-term comparison with others on social media: others seem to have 'wonderful lives',thereby Reinforcement the feeling of 'being just ordinary,not good enough',increasing stress and self-criticism.

special_situations.event: After falling in love this summer, facing expectations and self-demands in the intimate relationship
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am just ordinary,not more successful or outgoing,I do not deserve liking and approval
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces myself to step out of my comfort zone, trying to become bolder and more extroverted to prove my value
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should be more successful,bolder,cannot just be ordinary

special_situations.event: Whenever seeing others achieve great accomplishments or take bold adventures
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If not more outstanding than peers,it equals falling behind and failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently compares with others, pressures oneself to demand higher performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them,I should do more

special_situations.event: Browsing social media, seeing others' seemingly wonderful life and achievement displays
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my life is not as exciting as theirs,it means I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increasing social media browsing and self-evaluation, ignoring one's own positive side
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone is doing better than me; I am so mediocre

special_situations.event: When trying to affirm her own strengths (kindness, supporting family and friends)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only excellence and achievement count as value,virtues like kindness 'do not count'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating or devaluing one's own positive qualities,continuing self-criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These strengths are not enough,I am still not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be loved and recognized; hopes to be more 'outstanding'
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being seen as mediocre and thus ignored or not loved
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of control and worth through harsh self-reproach and constant comparison
Holding oneself to higher standards to avoid Being rejected

object_relations.self_representation: An ordinary and not-good-enough self,needing constant improvement to prove worth
object_relations.object_representation: Others/the world are picky judges who only approve of more successful, more outgoing people

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing others achieve success or display a wonderful life in reality or on social media
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing oneself clearly inferior to others,and that without becoming more outstanding one will be ignored or not loved
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond to their self-blame in a gentle,empathic tone,help identify the confusion between comparison and self-worth,invite them to specify the present experience,avoid judging.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited by others or the counselor to affirm her own strengths and practice self-acceptance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing 'kindness/supporting family' as not important enough,believing only greater success and boldness deserve recognition
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains a curious and supportive tone, gently restating her logic and guiding the identification of value conditions and emotional needs, encouraging lingering in the present feelings.

manifestations: Viewing 'more successful,bolder' as proof of existential worth,believing 'ordinary' have no value
Frequently comparing with others to confirm self-worth
Bound by many 'should' rules, feeling one must become a bigger, bolder self
Difficulty allowing the true self and present experience
Not yet talking about specific feelings with family and friends,difficulty exposing vulnerability
After falling in love, worries more about being ignored, intensifying comparison

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Statements of 'I should be more successful / more outgoing / bolder' repeatedly appear
Treats social media success narratives as standards that must be followed

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worries about being ignored and puts higher pressure on own performance
Distances from family and friends in real relationships due to self-blame

positive_force: Willing to seek help and actively participate in counseling
Able to identify and willing to challenge 'should' statements
Has a basic support network of family and friends
Open to practicing gratitude and restructuring
negative_force: Frequently compares with others; strong dependence on external evaluation
Introjected value conditions: equating 'excellence' with 'being valuable'
Reality filtering and distortion caused by social media
Strong self-criticism; hard to accept the ordinary self
Not yet expressing specific feelings to family and friends,so support is not yet utilized

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly comparing oneself and being harsh on oneself with 'should' sentences
antecedent: Seeing others achieve or take bold risks
Browsing the 'wonderful lives' on social media
Faces intimate-relationship expectations and self-demands after falling in love
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized value conditions and self-worth dependent on external comparison,believing mediocrity is not acceptable,and that one must be more successful and outgoing to deserve love and recognition
target_behavior.function: Seeks external recognition and avoids being seen as mediocre or ignored
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem,Declining academic performance,Interpersonal tension,decreased overall well-being and Reduced interest in daily activities
